description: This file contains the HTML structure and embedded JavaScript code for adding products to price books in the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for validating user input, handling form submissions, and updating price-related fields.

methods.name: addtopricebook
methods.description: Validates selected products and their list prices, constructs a list of selected product IDs, and sets the form's action URL for adding product-price book relationships.

methods.name: updateAllListPrice
methods.description: Updates list prices for all listed products based on a given unit price.
